# Brooklyn Therapy Services

> Therapy practice offering individual and couples therapy in person in Brooklyn, NY and online for clients anywhere in New York State. Out-of-network; superbills provided. Free 15-minute consultation.

Contact: info@brooklyntherapyservices.com

## Clinicians
- [Rachel Vetter, LCSW (Founder & Clinical Director)](https://brooklyntherapyservices.com/team/): OCD, anxiety, complex trauma, relationships, grief, depression, life transitions. ACT, CBT, psychodynamic, IFS, ERP.
- [Lily Berman, LMSW](https://brooklyntherapyservices.com/team/): anxiety, depression, grief, addiction, life transitions. Psychodynamic, ACT, CBT.
